Name: Zerahiah, Son of Uzzi
Summary: Son of Uzzi and priest in Aaron's line.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 6:6; 1 Chronicles 6:51: Son of Uzzi and priest in Aaron's line.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Zerahiah stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
